citations.title: RFC 8446: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3
RFC 9325: Recommendations for Secure Use of Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Datagram TLS (DTLS)

findings.remediation: Enable TLS 1.3 (RFC 9325 section 3.1.1: SHOULD support it, and prefer it). It is also the only protocol that can carry post-quantum key exchange.

findings.title: Certificates use classical (quantum-vulnerable) signatures
findings.detail: Certificate key algorithm(s): ECDSA 256-bit P-256. All are quantum-vulnerable signatures; this matters for future forgery, not for recorded traffic.

hygiene.methodology: TLS hygiene score: start at 100 and take off points for each finding on this result (critical 40, high 20, medium 10, low 4, info 0). Post-quantum findings are not counted; readiness is reported separately. Each distinct problem counts once. A critical finding limits the score to 29 (Broken) and a high finding to 74 (Fair). Bands: Strong 90 and above, Sound 75, Fair 55, Weak 30, Broken below. The weights are this project's own choice, not a standard, and are not derived from any other scanner's rating.
